paragraphs: Swyft Cities sells Whoosh, a transportation technology using autonomous electric vehicles that travel across a network of fixed cables and rails. Their pages state that the vehicles are zero emissions with minimal system infrastructure. Stations are described as the size of traditional bus stops, at ground level, elevated, or alongside upper levels of a building.

The company describes itself as the sole licensee of Whoosh Transportation Technology in North America and other designated geographies. Swyft Cities spun out of Google and is developing proprietary control systems. The pages name project feasibility, design, and implementation as the services offered.
For markets, the pages name real estate developments, airports, universities, and tourism destinations. Cities and developers are named as parties that can build more densely with less parking.

quote.text: Vehicles wait at stations for passengers, not the other way around.
